$comment: Scene transition choices (D327, TR1): the types and easing curves Settings > Transitions offers. The host (app/host/src/transition_ease.cpp ease::value) knows the formula of each curve (Penner easing equations; all monotonic in 0..1, so a fade never overshoots). An id the host does not know is refused there. linear = the plain libobs fade. Kinds with shader: true (2026-11-28) are the host's shader styles; they take a curve too, and subtle lengths (300 to 700 ms) suit them best.

kinds.label: Stinger (video)
kinds.help: A short video plays over the switch; the scene changes at the moment you pick. Pick a built-in one or your own video.

kinds.label: Cut
kinds.help: The new scene appears at once, with no effect.

kinds.label: Fade
kinds.help: The old scene melts into the new one.

kinds.label: Slide
kinds.help: The new scene pushes the old one out of the frame in the direction you pick.

kinds.label: Swipe
kinds.help: One scene moves over the other, which stays still. Switch on 'Swipe in' to bring the new scene in over the old one; off to swipe the old one away.

kinds.label: Wipe
kinds.help: The new scene is revealed through a pattern, such as a clock hand or blinds. Softness blurs the edge; Invert plays the pattern the other way round.

kinds.label: Colour fade
kinds.help: The picture fades to one colour, then from that colour to the new scene. The point is how far through the colour is at its strongest.

kinds.label: Blur zoom
kinds.help: The old scene pushes in and blurs, and the new scene settles into focus. Smooth and cinematic.

kinds.label: Light leak
kinds.help: A warm streak of film light sweeps across while the scenes cross. One soft glow, never a strobe.

kinds.label: Motion swipe
kinds.help: The new scene pushes the old one out with a fast camera-style motion blur, in the direction you pick.

kinds.label: Glitch
kinds.help: A short digital glitch: colours split and thin bands jump sideways at the switch. Safe for viewers: no flashing.

kinds.label: Heartbeat
kinds.help: The picture swells twice like a heartbeat, with a slight blur, as the new scene takes over.

kinds.label: Pop
kinds.help: The new scene pops in from slightly smaller with a quick bounce and settles in place.
